# Glass-Box AI Workflows

> The opposite of building AI agents: one AI agent that builds your team's automations for them. Self-hosted on your servers. Anyone on the team describes what they need in plain words via Slack, and the agent turns the request into a runnable n8n workflow. After the build, the workflow runs on cron with no further AI calls. Developers can reach the same agent through MCP. Six-layer architecture on a small cloud VM with Docker Compose. No vector database, no RAG, no per-seat fees, no managed agent platform.

## Architecture and documentation

- [README](./README.md): One-paragraph idea, the file map, what ships out of the box, who this is for.
- [Architecture](./ARCHITECTURE.md): Six layers (User · Orchestration · Agent · Tools · Memory · Foundation). Trust boundaries (LLM never passes identity, audit before mutation, scope gating at every level). What this is not.
- [Workflows](./WORKFLOWS.md): Eight production-ready templates that ship with the system. The template format (one JSON plus one short markdown spec). What you cannot have (no browser automation, no image generation, no customer-facing chat, no vector DB).

## Installation and pricing

- [Install](./INSTALL.md): What runs on your VM after install. What we need from you. The shape of a typical 1-to-2-day install. What is excluded.
- [Pricing](./PRICING.md): $2,500 fixed-price for setup plus training plus 30-day support. Three free installation slots for the first teams who commit. Trade for a free slot is one 30-minute interview after 60 days plus permission to anonymize and publish the install pattern.
- [Case study](./CASE-STUDY.md): The original anonymized case the system grew out of. Two workflows live in production, six more ready to launch. Fully-loaded cost per workflow $5 to $10.
